doc.title: Harry "Sweets" Edison interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Current plans and love of Paris
summary: Upcoming dates: Chicago with Clark Terry, Hollywood Bowl, the Kennedy Center, Paris; no more road work.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Tell us about what you’re doing today.

For the future? Well I’m not going on the road no three hundred one-nighters anymore that’s for sure. I’m through with that. But I have, I’m going to Chicago in the morning to play a festival with Clark Terry. And the 13th I’ll be at the Hollywood Bowl, the last jazz series of the summer, a tribute to Lionel Hampton which is called “Vibes.” And I’m going to the Kennedy Center on the 8th to play a concert there for the President with Lionel Hampton. And I’m going to Europe, going to Paris at a place called the Caveau de Huchette, it’s on the Left Bank there in Paris. I love Paris. I’ve been there many, many, many times. Parles vous Français? Petit peu?
I’m very fond of Paris, and in fact I’ve been all through Europe many, many, many times. I have a lot of friends over there. And I look forward to going over there to see my friends.
